question: What cycle life (number of cycles to 80% capacity) does the review report for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%Nb%' OR text ILIKE '%80%' AND text ILIKE '%cycl%' OR text ILIKE '%oxyfluoride%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page IN (9,10,11) AND (text ILIKE '%cycl%' OR text ILIKE '%80%' OR text ILIKE '%retention%') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (9,10,11) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%80%' OR text ILIKE '%cycle life%' OR text ILIKE '%capacity retention%' OR text ILIKE '%cycles%' ORDER BY page, id

runs.text: The review does not report a cycle life (number of cycles to a fixed fraction of capacity) for the oxyfluoride. It names the material only as a DRX oxyfluoride that relies on the redox center of manganese, "Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F which relies on the Mn^2 +/Mn^4 + redox center", and gives no cycle-life figure for it.

rendered: The review does not report a cycle life (number of cycles to a fixed fraction of capacity) for the oxyfluoride. It names the material only as a DRX oxyfluoride that relies on the redox center of manganese, "Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F which relies on the Mn^2 +/Mn^4 + redox center", and gives no cycle-life figure for it.[1]The only cycling data for this material is the inset of Fig. 9[2], which plots capacity against cycle number over a short run of cycles. Neither the caption nor the text states a retention threshold or the cycle at which capacity falls to it, so no cycle life can be read from the review.
